item.title: National Invest in Veterans Week celebrates veteran-owned businesses in West Virginia
item.description: March 1-7 is National Invest in Veterans Week, celebrating veteran-owned businesses and entrepreneurs, which make up a high percentage of West Virginia's population.

item.description: MASON COUNTY, W.Va. item.title: East Fairmont High School invites 8th-graders to aviation summit
item.description: More than 500 eighth-grade students in Marion County had the opportunity to learn more about the possibilities in the career field of aviation during a jam-packed day of hands-on learning experiences on Tuesday.

item.title: FCC investigating after antisemitic threats aired on Pittsburgh emergency channels
item.description: PITTSBURGH (WBOY) — Authorities, including the Federal Communications Commission (FCC), are investigating after antisemitic messages, Nazi propaganda and a threat against the Mayor of Pittsburgh were broadcast over emergency channels in the Steel City. item.title: 2 charged after infant allegedly found malnourished in Glenville
item.description: Two people are in custody and are facing charges in Glenville after an infant in their care was allegedly found malnourished.

item.title: Preston County Commission implements temporary flat business fee to fund EMS
item.description: In a lengthy County Commission meeting on Tuesday, Preston County officials discussed ways to bring in revenue amid the emergency services funding crisis.

item.title: Hope Gas opens new training facility in Harrison County
item.description: Hope Gas cut the ribbon on Tuesday for its new "state-of-the-art natural gas training facility” in Harrison County, which officials described as “a long-term investment into West Virginia’s workforce and the future of the state’s energy industry.”

item.title: Dead dog found chained up with tire on top in Harrison County; 2 charged
item.description: Two people have been charged after deputies learned about a deceased dog that was chained up with a tire on top of it in Harrison County.

item.title: Man arrested in homicide investigation near West Virginia border
item.description: A man has been arrested just over the West Virginia border in connection with the death of an elderly woman that was ruled a homicide.

item.title: Medical Examiner called to wreck in Bridgeport; 2 transported
item.description: The West Virginia Medical Examiner was alerted to a wreck on Benedum Drive north of Bridgeport Tuesday night that sent two people to the hospital.
